_comment: Conformance, Conflict Alert (CA) and Mode C Intruder (MCI) thresholds (docs/adr/0058, 0118). [SOURCE-DEFINED]: our own choices, not doctrine. formationLateralNm/formationVerticalFt: how close an uncorrelated target must be to a formation flight to count as one of its members (ADR 0118, ours; P/CG gives 1 mile and 100 ft for a standard formation). refueling*: the air refueling block relative to the tanker (ADR 0118). airspaceEntry: the airspace-entry alert ignores a track slower or younger than these (ADR 0119, ours). Override by placing a copy in state/alerting.json; missing keys fall back to these. headingTurnRateDegPerSec/headingTurnMaxBankDeg/headingGraceMarginSec: the heading grace is the turn at standard rate or at that bank, whichever is slower, plus the margin (H163; the rate and bank follow the AIM's holding turns, 5-3-8, sub-paragraph unchecked; the margin is ours). handoff: notCheckedInSec is how long a receiver may have an accepted HANDOFF without marking the aircraft checked in before its Strip asks for attention (ADR 0122, ours).
